name: Timeless Turf — Instant Form leads → Facebook lead router

mapper.data:
{
  "form_name": "instant-{{if(contains(lower(2.name); "membership"); "membership"; if(contains(lower(2.name); "putting"); "putting-green"; "clean"))}}",
  "form_title": "{{2.name}}",
  "created_at": "{{1.dateCreated}}",
  "site_url": "Facebook Instant Form",
  "data": {
    "name": "{{1.data.full_name}}",
    "phone": "{{1.data.phone_number}}",
    "email": "{{1.data.email}}",
    "zip": "{{ifempty(1.data.zip_code; 1.data.post_code)}}",
    "size": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "about_how_big_is_the_turf?"); get(1.data; "about_how_big_is_the_turf"))}}",
    "dogs": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "do_dogs_use_it?"); get(1.data; "do_dogs_use_it"))}}",
    "issue": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "what_bothers_you_most?"); get(1.data; "what_bothers_you_most"))}}",
    "plan_pick": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "which_plan_sounds_right?"); get(1.data; "which_plan_sounds_right"))}}",
    "green_size": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "how_big_is_the_green?"); get(1.data; "how_big_is_the_green"))}}",
    "green_issue": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "what_is_the_green_doing?"); get(1.data; "what_is_the_green_doing"))}}",
    "green_where": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "where_is_the_green?"); get(1.data; "where_is_the_green"))}}",
    "utm_source": "{{1.platform}}",
    "utm_medium": "instant_form",
    "utm_campaign": "{{1.campaignName}}",
    "utm_content": "{{1.adName}}",
    "utm_term": "{{1.adsetName}}",
    "page": "Instant Form: {{2.name}}",
    "lead_id": "{{1.leadgenId}}"
  }
}
